intro: How much space your games take on each drive.
about: Platypus measures the games it knows and never walks the rest of the disk: the bar shows what is yours, what is not, and what is free.
emptyBody: Installed games appear here with their size, their location and their Wine prefix.
uninstallAsk: Uninstall {{title}}? Its files leave the disk.

atlas.almostFull: Almost full. Installs on this drive will fail.
atlas.outsideEmpty: All installed games are in your game folders.

backups.title: Prefix backups
backups.intro: Old Wine prefixes kept when a reset replaced them. A backup may still hold saves from before the reset, so delete only what you no longer need.
backups.confirmBody: The old Wine prefix of {{title}} ({{name}}, {{size}}) is deleted for good, with any saves it still holds.
